project: Galaxy Z Fold8 — The Frame Unfolds
intent: Show that Galaxy Z Fold8 changes the shape of content rather than merely enlarging it.
must: Six visually distinct sections and a complete footer
Pinned hero and horizontal scroll narrative
Responsive recomposition at desktop, tablet, and phone
Disclosure that this is an independent design study
mustNot: Invent product specifications, reviews, awards, or testimonials
Repeat a centered hero or equal-card grid throughout
Use decorative indicators that measure nothing
